Omertà portraits: gallery

Every option of the painted portrait, in the grids that show fitting defects. Generated by npx tsx docs/portraits/build.ts; deterministic.

 

Every size the game shows

36–44 px: top bar, list rows, family-tree nodes. 48–64 px: rail and rows. 88–120 px: person page, conversation header. 176–380 px: the creation preview. Avatars in the game are round.

Clothes: his taste, dressed for his rank

Each row is one choice of clothes; each column a rank. Below a rank's floor the same taste is dressed up (a leather jacket becomes a car coat over a suit), and an associate is never overdressed.
